description_zh: 后世将仇英与沈周、文徵明、唐寅并称“明四家”，此归类由董其昌在四人全部去世后确立，非在世时的组织。
description_en: The grouping of Qiu Ying with Shen Zhou, Wen Zhengming, and Tang Yin as the Four Masters of the Ming was consolidated by Dong Qichang after all four had died; it was not a contemporary formation.

description_zh: 仇英出身漆工而未取科举功名，明四家中唯一的职业画家，其在画史上的崇高地位带有后世文献建构的色彩。
description_en: Qiu Ying rose from lacquer artisan origins and never took civil service exams. He was the only professional painter among the Four Masters; his elevated position in painting history reflects later canonical construction.

description_zh: 明末清初苏州作坊大量制造托名仇英的伪作，许多传世“仇英”作品的归属尚需鉴定。
description_en: Suzhou workshops produced extensive forgeries under Qiu Ying's name during the late Ming and early Qing; many surviving works attributed to him require authentication.
